entries.text: You see Rae.

entries.text: You don't belong here.
entries.source_text: You don't belong here.

entries.text: (seems confused and sad) I believe I do, but.. why are you here?
entries.source_text: (seems confused and sad) I believe I do, but.. why are you here?

entries.text: Neither do you.

entries.text: Uh.. yes I do. The master is having me scout around in disguise# to check our security.

entries.text: Yes I do, I'm here to kill you.

entries.text: Okay, I'm leaving.

entries.text: huh.
entries.source_text: huh.

entries.text: (sigh) What do you want now?

entries.text: I'm lost.. can you show me how to get to the master? I need to kill# him.

I'm lost.. can you show me how to get to the master? I need to kill
# him.

entries.text: Nothing. Goodbye.

entries.text: To see what you look like with all your skin ripped off your body,# you mutant scum.
entries.source_text:
To see what you look like with all your skin ripped off your body,
# you mutant scum.

entries.text: What's wrong with you?
entries.source_text: What's wrong with you?

entries.text: great oogly moogly.
entries.source_text: great oogly moogly.

entries.text: I'm here to... contemplate the oneness of the master.
entries.source_text: I'm here to... contemplate the oneness of the master.

entries.text: Of course. The unity brings peace. May I ask where you are from?
entries.source_text: Of course. The unity brings peace. May I ask where you are from?

entries.text: I am as well. I made the pilgrimage from far away to see the master# with my own eyes.
entries.source_text:
I am as well. I made the pilgrimage from far away to see the master
# with my own eyes.

entries.text: I have much to learn. How does one gain an audience with the master?
entries.source_text: I have much to learn. How does one gain an audience with the master?

entries.text: I did that yesterday. Today I'm contemplating what the master would# look like if I lit him on fire and roasted marshmallows over his putrid# carcass.
entries.source_text:
I did that yesterday. Today I'm contemplating what the master would
# look like if I lit him on fire and roasted marshmallows over his putrid
# carcass.

entries.text: I think the master is insane.
entries.source_text: I think the master is insane.

entries.text: I'm from... somewhere ..else.
entries.source_text: I'm from... somewhere ..else.

entries.text: What a coincidence! So am I.
entries.source_text: What a coincidence! So am I.

entries.text: Where?
entries.source_text: Where?

entries.text: I'm from a vault... I'm a pure strain human.
entries.source_text: I'm from a vault... I'm a pure strain human.

entries.text: What, are you an imbecile?
entries.source_text: What, are you an imbecile?

entries.text: Where are you from?
entries.source_text: Where are you from?

entries.text: (whispers) I'm from a vault... I'm a pure strain human.
entries.source_text: (whispers) I'm from a vault... I'm a pure strain human.

entries.text: I'd rather not say. Goodbye.
entries.source_text: I'd rather not say. Goodbye.

entries.text: A small village to the north of here.
entries.source_text: A small village to the north of here.

entries.text: Why should I tell you? You're just a lackey for the 'Man'.
entries.source_text: Why should I tell you? You're just a lackey for the 'Man'.

entries.text: Why would you tell me that? I should take you before the master...
entries.source_text: Why would you tell me that? I should take you before the master...

entries.text: But you won't
entries.source_text: But you won't

entries.text: You're welcome to try.
entries.source_text: You're welcome to try.

entries.text: Well, I should shove my gun down your throat and pull the trigger!
entries.source_text: Well, I should shove my gun down your throat and pull the trigger!

entries.text: Please don't.
entries.source_text: Please don't.

entries.text: I know why you're in so much pain.
entries.source_text: I know why you're in so much pain.

entries.text: I'll be going now.
entries.source_text: I'll be going now.

entries.text: You're right... if only I could clear my head. There's something...
entries.source_text: You're right... if only I could clear my head. There's something...

entries.text: I know why you can't clear your head.
entries.source_text: I know why you can't clear your head.

entries.text: The master keeps you from thinking clearly. Thinking disturbs the# unity.
entries.source_text:
The master keeps you from thinking clearly. Thinking disturbs the
# unity.

entries.text: The master is the reason you are in such pain.
entries.source_text: The master is the reason you are in such pain.

entries.text: Hey, I've got an idea - let's cut open the master and see what's# inside!!!
entries.source_text:
Hey, I've got an idea - let's cut open the master and see what's
# inside!!!

entries.text: Tell me! Please!!
entries.source_text: Tell me! Please!!

entries.text: You used to be human, too. The master dipped you in the FEV virus and# mutated you.
entries.source_text:
You used to be human, too. The master dipped you in the FEV virus and
# mutated you.

entries.text: Sorry, I can't.
entries.source_text: Sorry, I can't.

entries.text: Only the master can tell you everything.
entries.source_text: Only the master can tell you everything.

entries.text: Only the master can tell you everything. But you'd better talk to him# quick, 'cause I'm on my way to kill him.
entries.source_text:
Only the master can tell you everything. But you'd better talk to him
# quick, 'cause I'm on my way to kill him.

entries.text: Sorry, got to go.
entries.source_text: Sorry, got to go.

entries.text: I should kill you for taunting me!
entries.source_text: I should kill you for taunting me!

entries.text: I have a better idea - help me destroy the master for doing this to# you.
entries.source_text:
I have a better idea - help me destroy the master for doing this to
# you.

entries.text: No, you should kill the master for doing this to you. I'm on my way# to do just that... would you like to join me?
entries.source_text:
No, you should kill the master for doing this to you. I'm on my way
# to do just that... would you like to join me?

entries.text: Why? I'm not the one who turned you into a mutant!
entries.source_text: Why? I'm not the one who turned you into a mutant!

entries.text: You're welcome to try.
entries.source_text: You're welcome to try.

entries.text: No thanks. Bye!
entries.source_text: No thanks. Bye!

entries.text: Let's twist his head until his eyes pop out.
entries.source_text: Let's twist his head until his eyes pop out.

entries.text: You will never kill the master. He cannot die.
entries.source_text: You will never kill the master. He cannot die.

entries.text: You're right. I'd better get out of here.
entries.source_text: You're right. I'd better get out of here.

entries.text: We'll see about that.
entries.source_text: We'll see about that.

entries.text: Hmmm. I wonder how he'll continue to live when his unity is destroyed...
entries.source_text: Hmmm. I wonder how he'll continue to live when his unity is destroyed...

entries.text: That can't be.. the master.. protects... unifies...
entries.source_text: That can't be.. the master.. protects... unifies...

entries.text: Well, you're a living example of 'unification', my friend. I know,# I've seen the process. I'm here to stop the master from 'unifying' anyone# else.
entries.source_text:
Well, you're a living example of 'unification', my friend. I know,
# I've seen the process. I'm here to stop the master from 'unifying' anyone
# else.

entries.text: How does it feel to be protected and unified?
entries.source_text: How does it feel to be protected and unified?

entries.text: Yeah, he protects himself by controlling everyone else.
entries.source_text: Yeah, he protects himself by controlling everyone else.

entries.text: I've had enough of this. Goodbye.
entries.source_text: I've had enough of this. Goodbye.

entries.text: Leave now or I will be forced to deal with you.
entries.source_text: Leave now or I will be forced to deal with you.

entries.text: AAAUGH!!! (Grabs his head in pain and confusion) I.. can't...
entries.source_text: AAAUGH!!! (Grabs his head in pain and confusion) I.. can't...

entries.text: That's right, your friend the master stripped you of everything# you had in this world, including your humanity.
entries.source_text:
That's right, your friend the master stripped you of everything
# you had in this world, including your humanity.

entries.text: You know that it's true... that's why you're so confused. You're# fighting the mutation. Help me avenge you by destroying the master!
entries.source_text:
You know that it's true... that's why you're so confused. You're
# fighting the mutation. Help me avenge you by destroying the master!

entries.text: Sure you can. C'mon, let's kill the master, it will be fun.
entries.source_text: Sure you can. C'mon, let's kill the master, it will be fun.

entries.text: I'd better leave.
entries.source_text: I'd better leave.

entries.text: I'm sorry you're in such pain, but it's the master's fault.
entries.source_text: I'm sorry you're in such pain, but it's the master's fault.

entries.text: I will pull his eye out!! I'll tear his slimy little head from# its cables!!!! You, ...get out of here... I'll take care of the master.
entries.source_text:
I will pull his eye out!! I'll tear his slimy little head from
# its cables!!!! You, ...get out of here... I'll take care of the master.

entries.text: Great!!
entries.source_text: Great!!

entries.text: Thanks for the offer, but I'd like to do the job myself. Would# you like to help?
entries.source_text:
Thanks for the offer, but I'd like to do the job myself. Would
# you like to help?

entries.text: I'm going to stay here. I have some unfinished business.
entries.source_text: I'm going to stay here. I have some unfinished business.

entries.text: 你看到雷。
entries.source_text: 你看到雷。

entries.text: 你看到一个超级变种人。
entries.source_text: 你看到一个超级变种人。

entries.text: 你不属于这地方。
entries.source_text: 你不属于这地方。

entries.text: 【看上去迷茫而悲伤】我不这样想，可……你为什么在这？
entries.source_text: 【看上去迷茫而悲伤】我不这样想，可……你为什么在这？

entries.text: 你也一样。
entries.source_text: 你也一样。

entries.text: 啊……我是这儿的。主教让我装扮成这样的，为了检视我们的保安状况。
entries.source_text: 啊……我是这儿的。主教让我装扮成这样的，为了检视我们的保安状况。

entries.text: 我是这儿的，来这儿杀你的。
entries.source_text: 我是这儿的，来这儿杀你的。

entries.text: 好的，我这就走。
entries.source_text: 好的，我这就走。

entries.text: 哈。
entries.source_text: 哈。

entries.text: 【叹气】又怎么了？
entries.source_text: 【叹气】又怎么了？

entries.text: 我迷路了……能告诉我怎样接近主教吗？我得去杀他。
entries.source_text: 我迷路了……能告诉我怎样接近主教吗？我得去杀他。

entries.text: 没事，再见。
entries.source_text: 没事，再见。

entries.text: 来看看你的皮被扒掉了是个什么模样，你这个变种杂碎。
entries.source_text: 来看看你的皮被扒掉了是个什么模样，你这个变种杂碎。

entries.text: 你哪不对劲吗？
entries.source_text: 你哪不对劲吗？

entries.text: 很好，呜呜唔唔。
entries.source_text: 很好，呜呜唔唔。

entries.text: 我是来……我是来主教商量点事情的。
entries.source_text: 我是来……我是来主教商量点事情的。

entries.text: 当然。“同一”才有和平。能告诉我你从哪来吗？
entries.source_text: 当然。“同一”才有和平。能告诉我你从哪来吗？

entries.text: 哦，我啊。我走了相当长的一段路程就是想来亲眼见一见主教。
entries.source_text: 哦，我啊。我走了相当长的一段路程就是想来亲眼见一见主教。

entries.text: 要学的太多了。怎么才能从主教那里赢得人心啊？
entries.source_text: 要学的太多了。怎么才能从主教那里赢得人心啊？

entries.text: 我昨天这么干过。今天我是要来在主教身上点把火，还要在他恶心的尸体上烤点蘑菇，双头牛睾丸之类的，那会是怎样一副盛景啊！
entries.source_text: 我昨天这么干过。今天我是要来在主教身上点把火，还要在他恶心的尸体上烤点蘑菇，双头牛睾丸之类的，那会是怎样一副盛景啊！

entries.text: 我觉得主教是疯了。
entries.source_text: 我觉得主教是疯了。

entries.text: 我是从那个地方来的……就那个。
entries.source_text: 我是从那个地方来的……就那个。

entries.text: 太巧了，我也是！
entries.source_text: 太巧了，我也是！

entries.text: 哪？
entries.source_text: 哪？

entries.text: 我从避难所来……是血统纯正的人类。
entries.source_text: 我从避难所来……是血统纯正的人类。

entries.text: 什么？你是傻子吗？
entries.source_text: 什么？你是傻子吗？

entries.text: 你从哪来？
entries.source_text: 你从哪来？

entries.text: 【小声地说】我从避难所来……是血统纯正的人类。
entries.source_text: 【小声地说】我从避难所来……是血统纯正的人类。

entries.text: 我不想说。再见。
entries.source_text: 我不想说。再见。

entries.text: 北面的一个小村子。
entries.source_text: 北面的一个小村子。

entries.text: 干嘛告诉你。你只是那个“人”的跟班而已。
entries.source_text: 干嘛告诉你。你只是那个“人”的跟班而已。

entries.text: 跟我说那个干嘛？我应该在主教之前就……
entries.source_text: 跟我说那个干嘛？我应该在主教之前就……

entries.text: 但你不会。
entries.source_text: 但你不会。

entries.text: 那就试试啊。
entries.source_text: 那就试试啊。

entries.text: 啊，我该把枪插进你喉咙然后扣动扳机！
entries.source_text: 啊，我该把枪插进你喉咙然后扣动扳机！

entries.text: 请别那么做。
entries.source_text: 请别那么做。

entries.text: 我知道你为什么这么痛苦。
entries.source_text: 我知道你为什么这么痛苦。

entries.text: 现在我要走了。
entries.source_text: 现在我要走了。

entries.text: 你说的对……只要我能理清思绪。有什么事情……
entries.source_text: 你说的对……只要我能理清思绪。有什么事情……

entries.text: 你知道为什么你不能正常思考。
entries.source_text: 你知道为什么你不能正常思考。

entries.text: 是主教阻止你思考的。思想会妨碍团结统一。
entries.source_text: 是主教阻止你思考的。思想会妨碍团结统一。

entries.text: 主教是你痛苦的根源。
entries.source_text: 主教是你痛苦的根源。

entries.text: 嘿，我有主意了－不如把主教切开看看里面到底是什么玩意儿。
entries.source_text: 嘿，我有主意了－不如把主教切开看看里面到底是什么玩意儿。

entries.text: 告诉我！拜托！！
entries.source_text: 告诉我！拜托！！

entries.text: 以前你也是人类。是主教把你扔进FEV病毒池里使你突变的。
entries.source_text: 以前你也是人类。是主教把你扔进FEV病毒池里使你突变的。

entries.text: 抱歉，我不能。
entries.source_text: 抱歉，我不能。

entries.text: 只有主教能告诉你一切。
entries.source_text: 只有主教能告诉你一切。

entries.text: 只有主教能告诉你一切。但你最好快点找他谈，我可要去杀他了。
entries.source_text: 只有主教能告诉你一切。但你最好快点找他谈，我可要去杀他了。

entries.text: 抱歉，我得走了。
entries.source_text: 抱歉，我得走了。

entries.text: 你瞧不起我，我该杀了你。
entries.source_text: 你瞧不起我，我该杀了你。

entries.text: 我有个主意－杀了主教，看他对你做了什么啊。
entries.source_text: 我有个主意－杀了主教，看他对你做了什么啊。

entries.text: 不，你该杀主教，看他对你做了什么啊。我正要这么干呢，想跟我一起吗？
entries.source_text: 不，你该杀主教，看他对你做了什么啊。我正要这么干呢，想跟我一起吗？

entries.text: 为什么？又不是我把你变成这样的。
entries.source_text: 为什么？又不是我把你变成这样的。

entries.text: 你可以试试啊。
entries.source_text: 你可以试试啊。

entries.text: 不了。回见。
entries.source_text: 不了。回见。

entries.text: 咱们去把他的头拧烂，让他的眼珠子爆出来。
entries.source_text: 咱们去把他的头拧烂，让他的眼珠子爆出来。

entries.text: 你杀不了主教。他不会死的。
entries.source_text: 你杀不了主教。他不会死的。

entries.text: 说的对。我得离开这。
entries.source_text: 说的对。我得离开这。

entries.text: 咱们走着瞧吧。
entries.source_text: 咱们走着瞧吧。

entries.text: 恩。当他的教派被毁了之后，看他还能不能活下去……
entries.source_text: 恩。当他的教派被毁了之后，看他还能不能活下去……

entries.text: 那不可能……主教保卫我们……团结我们……
entries.source_text: 那不可能……主教保卫我们……团结我们……

entries.text: 哈，朋友，你就是那“同一”活生生的例子。我知道是怎么回事。我就是来阻止主教“同一”其他人的。
entries.source_text: 哈，朋友，你就是那“同一”活生生的例子。我知道是怎么回事。我就是来阻止主教“同一”其他人的。

entries.text: 被神保卫，团结一致，是什么感觉？
entries.source_text: 被神保卫，团结一致，是什么感觉？

entries.text: 啊，对啊，他通过控制所有人来保护他自己。
entries.source_text: 啊，对啊，他通过控制所有人来保护他自己。

entries.text: 够了！再见！
entries.source_text: 够了！再见！

entries.text: 马上离开，不然我就必须解决你了。
entries.source_text: 马上离开，不然我就必须解决你了。

entries.text: 啊啊啊啊！【他抱着头，痛苦迷茫的】我……不能……
entries.source_text: 啊啊啊啊！【他抱着头，痛苦迷茫的】我……不能……

entries.text: 这就对了，主教剥夺了你在这世界上所有的一切，包括你做人类的权利。
entries.source_text: 这就对了，主教剥夺了你在这世界上所有的一切，包括你做人类的权利。

entries.text: 你知道这是真的……这就是你迷惑的原因。你在跟变异抗争。帮我摧毁主教吧，这也是替你自己报仇。
entries.source_text: 你知道这是真的……这就是你迷惑的原因。你在跟变异抗争。帮我摧毁主教吧，这也是替你自己报仇。

entries.text: 你当然能。来吧，咱们去杀了主教，肯定很有趣的。
entries.source_text: 你当然能。来吧，咱们去杀了主教，肯定很有趣的。

entries.text: 我最好走了。
entries.source_text: 我最好走了。

entries.text: 看到你这么痛苦我很抱歉，但这是主教干的好事。
entries.source_text: 看到你这么痛苦我很抱歉，但这是主教干的好事。

entries.text: 我要把他的眼挖出来。我要把他粘乎乎的头从那些电线里扯出来！！！你……最好离开这里……我会料理主教的。
entries.source_text: 我要把他的眼挖出来。我要把他粘乎乎的头从那些电线里扯出来！！！你……最好离开这里……我会料理主教的。

entries.text: 很好！！
entries.source_text: 很好！！

entries.text: 谢谢你这么说，但我想自己做这事。想帮忙吗？
entries.source_text: 谢谢你这么说，但我想自己做这事。想帮忙吗？

entries.text: 我要留下。我还有点事没干完。
